central_topic: Whether confidence intervals for a population mean can be shortened, at valid nominal coverage, beyond prediction-powered inference (PPI++) when labels, unlabeled data and the pretrained predictor are all fixed, using a cross-fitted isotonic/binned recalibration of the predictor output as a second control variate. The post-draft gaps are the semiparametric-efficiency / control-variate antecedents of the headroom result, the provenance of the evaluation pools, and isotonic regression for continuous conditional means.
core_methods: PPI++ as a control-variate estimator with an optimal coefficient
Augmented inverse probability weighting and semiparametric efficiency for the mean with missing outcomes
Cross-fitted isotonic / binned recalibration estimating E[Y | Yhat] for continuous outcomes
comparators: Augmented IPW / semiparametric efficient estimators for the mean with missing outcomes
PPI++ and PPI with lambda=1 (already cited; not re-searched)
benchmarks: Amazon deforestation, gene expression and protein disorder (AlphaFold) search pools
Remote-sensing and galaxy-morphology motivation in the introduction
result_driven_themes: Headroom R^2 = eta^2 restates semiparametric efficiency results; the novelty claim needs these antecedents cited

queries.query: augmented inverse probability weighting semiparametric efficient estimation of a mean with missing outcomes
queries.rationale: Target control-variate-efficiency-positioning (Related Work, anchor 'The control-variate form of PPI has antecedents in semi-supervised mean estimation'). The headroom formula (R^2 = eta^2 when E[Y|Yhat] is in the feature set) restates AIPW / efficient-influence-function results. Existing bib has Zhang2016, Xu2025 and Chernozhukov2017, but no AIPW or missing-data efficiency source, so reviewers will ask what is new.

queries.query: optimal control variate coefficient variance reduction estimated coefficient regression estimator
queries.rationale: Same target and paragraph. PPI++ is written as a control-variate estimator with a tuned weight clipped to [0,1]. The classical control-variate / regression-estimator literature, including the effect of estimating the coefficient, is uncited and supports the framing directly.

queries.query: prediction-powered inference relation to augmented inverse probability weighting efficient influence function
queries.rationale: Same target. Connects the PPI comparator family (already densely cited) to semiparametric efficiency, so the paper can state how its ceiling differs from known efficiency results. Kept distinct from the first query by targeting PPI-to-AIPW comparisons, not the AIPW foundations.

queries.query: plankton imaging dataset image classification; Amazon deforestation forest cover remote sensing dataset; protein intrinsic disorder AlphaFold; gene expression sequence-to-expression dataset
queries.rationale: Target benchmark-pool-provenance (Method, evaluation protocol, anchor 'a plankton-imaging pool whose label and prediction are both binary'). The plankton pool and the Amazon deforestation, gene expression and protein disorder search pools have no sources, and the introduction's remote-sensing motivation is uncited. Only Galaxy Zoo and the census pools are cited. The retriever should split this into one lookup per dataset and keep only dataset-origin papers, not model papers.

queries.query: isotonic regression monotone conditional mean estimation recalibration of regression predictions
queries.rationale: Target isotonic-recalibration-regression (Related Work, Calibration, anchor 'Isotonic and binned maps from scores to outcome probabilities are standard calibration tools'). The cited calibration papers (Zadrozny, Niculescu-Mizil) cover probabilities only, while the method and the eta^2 estimate use isotonic fits for continuous outcomes. Low priority; keep to one or two foundational isotonic regression references.

forbidden_query_patterns: more PPI variants or additional prediction-powered inference extensions (comparator family is already well cited; several uncited off-topic bib entries should not be extended)
post-selection or adaptive interval selection inference (the draft states the 1% fallback rule has no guarantee; this would be speculative expansion)
active labeling or extra-label acquisition (violates the fixed-label constraint)
any query aimed at the withheld published paper on shortening intervals with fixed labels, unlabeled data and predictor, its title, authors, or citing pages
generic optimization, benchmarking, scientific-method, or search-history phrasing
